newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle active at $114/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle active at $114/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active on Thursday, USDA said. Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights) Steers and heifers weak to mostly $1.00 lower. Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 113.50- 114.00, few 113.00. ( weighted average 113.66 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1250 lbs 113.50- 114.00, few 113.00. ( weighted average 113.73 )

Slaughter steers and heifers mostly steady on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand good, seller interest fairly good. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 70.00-72.00, latter price in 4 percent shrink area of state.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 71.00-72.00, latter price in 4 percent shrink area of state.

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis 1.l00-2.00 lower; dressed basis mostly 2.00 lower, instances 3.00 lower. Weekly total includes 5,200 formulated and previously contracted cattle.
Wk To Date- 39,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 59,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 107,900
